title: Bontrager Kwaremont RSL TLR Road Tire
notes: Official Trek US page read 2026-11-01: US$99.99. 320 TPI cotton casing; Road Dual-Compound; semi-slick; tubeless ready/clincher; 'race-level speed with high-volume comfort'; 'Compatible with hooked and hookless rims (max pressures vary by size and type)'. 700C x 32 mm 345 g, max 75 psi; 35 mm 380 g, 70 psi; 38 mm 400 g, 65 psi.
